title: Tom Jones

vibeProfile.oneLine: A warm-hearted foundling stumbles across England toward love and his true birth.

summary: A foundling of unknown parentage, the good-hearted and hot-blooded Tom Jones is thrown out of his benefactor's house and tumbles across eighteenth-century England toward London, love, and the truth of his birth. Fielding tells his hero's misadventures with enormous warmth and a genial narrator forever leaning in to comment, building one of the great comic novels and an early masterpiece of the form. Long, generous and full of life, it is a rollicking human comedy that helped teach the novel how to be entertaining.
whyReadIt: A huge, warm, rollicking comic novel that helped invent the form. Fielding's foundling hero is impossible not to love.

funFacts.text: Fielding gave the book a chatty narrator who addresses the reader directly, a device far ahead of its time.
